ENTRY — node src/server.mjs (npm start) · SOLOFACTORY_HOME data dir · SOLOFACTORY_DEMO=1 fixture mode
REST /api: health · config · interview/turn · jobs (create · list · get) · telemetry · artifacts · cancel · resume · retry · recovery-packet
static dashboard served from public/ · one active build at a time — a second POST /api/jobs is refused with 409
FACTORY CONTROLLER — src/factory.mjs (SoloFactory) · one active run
state machine over stages; every transition is persisted and mirrored as an event; single-run lock (factory.active · busyJobId)
every stage except the controller's own gates invokes one bounded coding-agent turn with a role prompt (prompts.mjs); a verifying failure loops into repairing (≤ maxRepairs = 2) then re-verifies
reviewing audits the app against the frozen contract and is followed by a final test+build verify before deploying; any terminal failure parks with a structured recovery
change; cancel aborts the active worker

HUMAN LOOP — failures pause for the owner
recovery v2 keeps the workspace and evidence; the owner fixes the concrete blocker (e.g. xcode-select), then Resume current run
continues the SAME run id from its failed stage — Start over is an explicit secondary action · restart marks ambiguous runs interrupted

how agent turns happen, how the environment stays clean, and where run state is durably kept — all local
